Name: Sam Relationship Events - Testing (Expanded Interactions)
Author: Thalassie
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]This Mod is basically just an expanded interactions, I'm quite new to coding in general so there will be many bugs but I've tested it out and the events do work. (I made it on Mac so idk for others but give it a try!)[/color]
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Click Download, Place in your mods folder, start game.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Since its just expanded interactions, first will start if you skip 2 day by the bed, the others will start when you die in the cavern and your character is in the clinic. [/color]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
THIS SHOULD WORK WITH OTHER MODS...I don't know about certain furniture mods or retexture ones for the area.
[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
The Mods I used in the images: https://cafe.naver.com/starvall/248750
